# `company.invoice_batches`

One run of batch invoicing: what it was asked for, where the customers came from, and what it did.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | ix_invoice_batches_group | — | Stable ULID of this batch run. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this batch record was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this batch record. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this batch record. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Company audit event that recorded this batch run. |
| `date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Invoice date every invoice in this batch was asked for. |
| `billing_group_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_invoice_batches_group | — | Billing group the customers came from; null when an explicit list was given. Recorded, not referenced: a batch is history and keeps what it was addressed to even after the group is deleted. |

| `requested_count` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Customers this run attempted, one invoice each. |

| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency the created totals are stated in. |
| `request_snapshot` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Versioned typed JSON object of the exact request this run was given, so a retry re-asks the same question. |
